remarks: This newly renovated corner apartment offers an abundance of natural light, spacious hardwood flooring, and modern stainless steel appliances. The well-designed layout maximizes space and functionality, while large windows allow fresh air to flow throughout the home. An in-unit washer and dryer add to the convenience, and the charming fireplace serves as a beautiful focal point (for cosmetic purposes only). Additional perks include a dedicated storage unit in the basement and one assigned parking spot. Tenant is responsible for electricity, including heat and hot water. The owner requires a minimum credit score of 650 and a gross monthly income of at least three times the rent. Pets are considered at the owner's discretion, with a $45 monthly fee per pet (no aggressive breeds). Conveniently located near major highways, including I-95 and the Merritt Parkway, commuting is a breeze, and the East Norwalk train station provides easy access to Stamford and New York City. Just minutes from the vibrant South Norwalk (SONO) district, residents can enjoy a variety of restaurants, cafes, and shopping. For those who love the outdoors, Calf Pasture Beach and several parks are just a short drive away, offering great spaces for relaxation and recreation.
